scripts.restart: podman compose down && podman compose up -d
scripts.db:connect: podman exec -it dev-kitchen psql -U dratharias -d dev-kitchen
scripts.db:backup: podman exec dev-kitchen sh -c 'pg_dump -U dratharias dev-kitchen' > backups/dev-kitchen.sql
scripts.db:restore: podman exec -i dev-kitchen sh -c 'psql -U dratharias -d dev-kitchen' < backups/dev-kitchen.sql
scripts.clean: podman compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && podman system prune -af --volumes
scripts.prisma:migrate: podman exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy'
